notes: The subject publishes an adapter-configured object class, then unpublishes that entire class through IEEE 1516.1-2025. A fresh standard IEEE 1516.2-2025 publication query verifies the MIM NULL response: one class-count parameter set to zero, with no object-class or attribute-list parameters. No DDM services are used.

requirements.statement: The federate unpublishes its complete object-class publication through the standard Unpublish Object Class service. A subsequent standard publication query reflects that declaration state.

After whole-class unpublication leaves no published object classes, the publication query returns the exact MIM NULL response: a zero class count and omitted object-class and attribute-list parameters.
